purpose: Bounded software check of ancestry-bookkeeping equivalence; no full Task5 retry, biological recovery or readiness claim.

attempts.failure: Default arm completed. Fixed-interval arm failed before simulation because Eidos requires named arguments in signature order. Frozen source/protocol/logs/output retained.

attempts.repair: Only changed named-argument order: initializeTreeSeq(simplificationInterval=20, timeUnit="generations"). Default script and comparison runner bytes unchanged.

limitations: One fixed synthetic fixture and seed; it does not prove equivalence for every simulation or rejection path.
This fixture includes exactly one forced call to the existing generated stdpopsim restore function. It did not require additional natural rejection restores.
Canonical comparisons ignore tree-sequence serialization/provenance/internal IDs, while requiring sampled pedigree/genome identity, marginal ancestry and selected genotypes to match.
Neutral overlay after forward simulation was not performed; downstream bitwise VCF identity is not asserted.
The short-job scheduler RSS sampling is not a credible peak-memory measurement; no memory-savings estimate is reported.
Full-chromosome Task5 memory feasibility remains unresolved. The original22GiB OOM remains a failure. No production default or frozen biological protocol changed.

An additional local postrun recomputation was unavailable because the local review environment lacks pyslim; postrun recomputation against retained trees succeeded using the recorded Betty environment.
